_README: Registry of data sources that are gone, moved, or newly gated.
A source listed here is SKIPPED cleanly instead of failing every cycle.
DEAD       — the source no longer exists. Do not call it.
NEEDS_AUTH — the source still exists but now requires a credential.
If env_key is set in the environment, the source is used
normally; if not, it is skipped quietly (not an error).
Remove an entry (or flip its status) once the source is restored/keyed.
recheck_after is a hint for a human, nothing reads it automatically.

ucdp_api.reason: UCDP introduced token authentication. Every endpoint now returns 401 with body 'API token required. Add header: x-ucdp-access-token: <your-token>'. The old code additionally used a wrong resource name ('conflict' -> now 'ucdpprioconflict') and stale versions (25.1/24.1/23.1/22.1 -> now 26.1), so it was 404-ing on top of being unauthenticated. Both are fixed; only the token is missing.
ucdp_api.how_to_reenable: Request a token from the UCDP API maintainer (see https://ucdp.uu.se/apidocs/), then put UCDP_ACCESS_TOKEN=<token> in .env

interim_local_fallback.status: ACTIVE since 2026-07-13 — the axis is LIT, not dark
interim_local_fallback.why: The token request is pending (maintainer away until Aug 2026), but the full datasets are freely downloadable without a key from https://ucdp.uu.se/downloads/. UCDP/PRIO ACD is a YEARLY release, so a one-time local snapshot is not a staleness risk: there is nothing newer to fetch until the next annual release.
interim_local_fallback.precedence: If UCDP_ACCESS_TOKEN appears, the live API wins automatically and the CSV is ignored. No code change needed.
interim_local_fallback.note: This entry stays NEEDS_AUTH because the API genuinely is gated. The registry describes the API's status, not the axis's.
